description: This file defines a Kotlin interface for API endpoints related to events and an object for creating a Retrofit API client, facilitating network operations for an Android calendar application.

classes.name: EventsApi
classes.description: An interface defining REST API endpoints for managing calendar events asynchronously with suspend functions.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: An object providing a lazily initialized singleton Retrofit-based API client for network operations.

methods.name: listInRange
methods.description: Retrieves a list of events within a specified time range asynchronously.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new event with the provided request data asynchronously.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific event by ID asynchronously.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing event identified by ID with provided data asynchronously.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an event identified by ID asynchronously.
